_comment: OIDC client registry for the local stack (deploy/compose.yml), mounted at
to. The dbal image ships no clients.json of its own, so without this mount
the provider fails to initialize even with DBAL_OIDC_ISSUER set.
Only nextjs-web is registered: this stack runs exactly one app. The wider
registry (pastebin, codegen, workflowui, ...) lives in the dbal repo at
truth for deployments that serve more than one client.
redirect_uris are matched exactly, port included. 8080 is HTTP_PORT's
default; if you start the stack on another port, add that origin here or
/oidc/authorize will reject the callback as unregistered.
8080' forwarding to this same nginx over a Tailscale-issued HTTPS cert --
needed because browsers only treat https://, localhost and 127.0.0.1 as a
secure context, and PKCE's crypto.subtle is unavailable outside one. A
bare Tailscale MagicDNS hostname over plain http:// will still fail.
